0.text: You must be $NAME. Your reputation travels before you, friend.

1.text: Welcome to our little town of New Kingsport, the last remaining vestibule of the Kingsport Monarchs of old.

0.text: As I said, your reputation precedes you, and I must admit I’m grateful that you have shown yourself to be so willing to help those in need… because… I and my town? We are in need.

1.text: An anthropologist from the Traveling Brothers of Science has been spending her past year researching those horrific reptilian tribes hidden in the bush. Problem is, she’s recently gone missing.

2.text: If you have time, I would greatly appreciate it if you could find her. Missing folk from the big city doesn’t look too good when attracting new citizens, and it’s hard enough as it is...

0.text: She has a house near the water's edge on the West side of town. It's a brown two story with stairs around the back.

1.text: She often locked herself away in the top floor, scribbling away on a parchment and mumbling to herself. That might be the best place to start.
Thanks I'll be on my way.

0.text: Come see us again, theres something I need...
Good to see you again $NAME. Thanks for finding that nosey woman for me. I don’t think she’ll be venturing out alone for a while.

1.text: Now she’s far too busy, trying to translate that damn codex. Enjoy the rest of your stay in our village.
